summary: End-to-end verification of the Danışmanlık enhancements (badge, propose modal, emails, calendar, card-only purchase). Backend pytest 9/9 pass on /app/backend/tests/test_consulting.py (config+price, admin credit, fresh-student zero credit, pending-count endpoint increments after booking and decrements on reject, slot locking regression, admin approve happy path, propose sets 'rescheduled' with proposed_date/time, /consulting/purchase returns 503 with Turkish 'yapılandırılmadı' detail when PayTR is unset, admin email_templates contains consulting_approved/rejected/proposed keys). Frontend Playwright as admin: after booking a slot from /panel > tab-consulting, the calendar shows highlighted days, slot chip slot-2026-08-31-10:00 opens confirm-booking dialog, consulting-credits drops from '1 saat' to '0 saat'. Sidebar consulting-nav-badge shows '1' at /yonetim. On /yonetim/danismanlik, propose-booking-<id> opens the new modal with propose-date + propose-time + propose-note + submit-propose (all data-testids present); submitting sets booking to rescheduled. Reject cleanup restored admin to 1 credit. Buy flow (buy-consulting) shows the Turkish 'Kart ile ödeme henüz yapılandırılmadı' toast (503), and NO Havale/IBAN dialog is opened for consulting. Mobile 390x844 layout for the student consulting tab renders without overflow (screenshot mobile_consulting.png).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_consulting.consulting_purchase creates an order row BEFORE checking PayTR credentials — when creds are missing it still leaves a 'pending' orders doc with payment_method='paytr'. Consider inserting the order only after credentials are validated, or mark it 'failed' when raising 503 to avoid orphaned pending orders.

Admin propose modal HTML <input type='date'> uses the browser-native date picker; per project convention, shadcn Calendar/Popover is preferred for consistency. Not blocking, but a UX inconsistency vs. student-side which uses the shadcn Calendar.

STATUS_TR and pending-count both key off status='pending'; 'rescheduled' is not counted in pending-count. This is per spec (only new requests badge) but worth documenting so admins know rescheduled items aren't reflected in the badge.
Emergent build injects <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> children (React hydration warning). Harmless but console-noisy; consider not mapping i18n text as JSX inside <option>.
